events.title: Marriage to Nicholas Butchko
events.description: Married about 50 years when he died (per obituary summary); exact date not found. She was still single and at home in April 1950.

bioAdditions: In 1940 Angeline was 18, living at home on Philo Street and keeping house; she had completed one year of high school (S1). She married Nicholas Butchko, apparently in the 1950s, and they were married about fifty years before his death. In 2008 she was living in Chinchilla, north of Scranton (S3). She survived her brother Joseph, who died in May 2009 (S4), and according to a summary of her own obituary died later in 2009, aged 87, in the hospice unit of Mercy Hospital, Scranton (S2).
